source: Previously saved3-fold group-OOF baseline XGBoost probabilities from original training only.
method: find_label_issues default prune_by_noise_rate,frac_noise1,n_jobs1,rankbyself_confidence. Run raw scores and a fixed training-class-weight reversal sensitivity check. No label/row changes.
limitation: Class-weighted model scores are not calibrated true probabilities. Reversing fit-fold class weights is only an approximate sensitivity analysis, not calibration. Flag fractions are model-dependent review candidates, NOT verified mislabeled fractions or an accuracy ceiling.
